definitions.explanation: A moderate cooking temperature between low heat ({弱火|よわび}) and high heat ({強火|つよび}). One of the standard heat settings referred to in Japanese cooking instructions.

examples.japanese: {中火|なかび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}めて→炒める：01879_itameru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{中火|なかび}にして5⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
examples.english: Set to medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強火|つよび}→強火：08170_tsuyobi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{沸騰|ふっとう}→沸騰：03145_futtou⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{中火|なかび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: First bring to a boil on high heat, then reduce to medium heat.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the three standard heat levels used in Japanese cooking:
- ⟦{弱火|よわび}→弱火：08168_yowabi⟧ (low heat)
- {中火|なかび} (medium heat)
- ⟦{強火|つよび}→強火：08170_tsuyobi⟧ (high heat)

Additionally, ⟦とろ{火|び}→とろ火：08577_torobi⟧ (very low heat/simmer) is sometimes used. These terms appear constantly in recipes and cooking instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中火|なかび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (to grill on medium heat)
- {中火|なかび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧ (to simmer on medium heat)
- {中火|なかび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to set to medium heat)
- {中火|なかび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ (to reduce to medium heat)
